title: Witness transport identifies the normalized proper/open isomorphism with the clopen-projection mate
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Let $f:X	o Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $c_i=(j_i:X\hookrightarrow\overline X_i,p_i:\overline X_i	o Y)$ be compactifications, and let $v:c_1	o c_2$ be a proper refinement, so $vj_1=j_2$ and $p_2v=p_1$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ modules on the small pro-etale sites. Write $J_i=j_{i!}$ for exact extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Let $(M,H,a)$ be an etale-origin witness: $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $H\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $a:
u_X^*H\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Let $\alpha^p_v(H):J_2
u_X^*H\xrightarrow{\sim}Rv_*J_1
u_X^*H$ be the specified comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison-proetale], and set
$$\Gamma_v(M,H,a)=Rv_*J_1(a)\circ\alpha^p_v(H)\circ J_2(a)^{-1}.$$
This is precisely the proper/open isomorphism in part (a) of [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism]. For the commutative proper/open square with top $j_1$, bottom $j_2$, left edge $1_X$, and right edge $v$, let $\gamma_v:J_2	o Rv_*J_1$ be the finite proper-adjunction mate normalized in [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate]: base-change $Lv^*J_2$ to the inverse image of $j_2(X)$, project onto its clopen section $(j_1,1_X)$, and transpose under $Lv^*\dashv Rv_*$. The opens $j_i$ are quasi-compact since the compactification schemes are finite type over $k$. Then the equality of actual maps is
$$\Gamma_v(M,H,a)=\gamma_{v,M}.$$
More explicitly, with $e_j:
u^*j_!^{\mathrm{et}}\cong j_!
u^*$ and $b_v:
u^*Rv_{\mathrm{et},*}\cong Rv_*
u^*$ the canonical comparisons of [lem-sf-proper-open-comparison-site-normalization], and $\gamma^e_v$ the finite etale proper/open comparison of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], one has
$$\gamma_{v,
u_X^*H}=Rv_*(e_{j_1,H})\circ b_{v,j_{1!}^{\mathrm{et}}H}\circ
u^*(\gamma^e_{v,H})\circ e_{j_2,H}^{-1}.$$
The equality is natural in the witnessed object, and holds separately for any witnessed bounded-below tensor input; no constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The compactification factorization and QuasiCompact f make both open immersions quasi-compact. Apply finiteClopenMateSiteTransport to (j1,j2,1,v). Its etale mate equals normalizedComparison. The canonical direct-image identity law says N(e^{-1}) b_1 = d^{-1}; this is comparisonDirectImagePlus_id followed by cancellation of d. Naturality of the open-extension comparison moves N(e^{-1}) across it. Cancel the forward open comparison to obtain refinementSiteWordPlus_eq, the four-factor formula for the identity-normalized bounded-below pro-etale mate.

proof.text: Apply properOpenRefinementMate_plus_compatibility to N(H), an arbitrary bounded-below pro-etale input. Substitute the bounded-below formula from Step 1. Naturality transports this equality across the canonical exact comparison N(H) included in D versus N applied to the included H, giving refinementMate_eq_siteWord with precisely the source and target compatibility factors in purityRefinementSiteWord.

proof.text: The refinement clause of properOpenInterchangeCoherence identifies purityEtaleRefinementComparison with the specified etale properOpenComparison. Expand properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus into its four factors and properOpenProEtaleIso into its canonical inclusion comparisons. Thus purityRefinementSiteWord is exactly its hom. This is the site-normalization equation directly from the named construction, valid for the size-lifted coefficient ring without re-presenting the coefficients.

proof.text: Expand refinementProperOpenIsoFixed as J2(a^{-1}), the specified pro-etale comparison, and Rv J1(a). By Steps 2 and 3 replace the middle factor by the proper mate at N(H). Naturality at a, followed by functoriality and a^{-1}a=1, cancels the outer factors and gives the proper mate at M. This proves the first clause; Step 2 is the second clause. For any two witnesses and any underlying arrow t, rewrite both transported maps by the first clause and apply naturality of purityRefinementMate. This proves the last clause. The argument applies separately to any bounded-below tensor input with a witness.

Statement and stmt_deps are identical to live and side-live, where the item is still unsplit with no proof, and no re-split note applies. Step 1: part (a) of def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism (K0=k) gives Gamma_v=S(a)alpha^p J2(a)^{-1} and Noetherian compactifications, so the square (j1,j2,1_X,v) meets the hypotheses of lem-cbc-finite-clopen-mate-site-transport (finite Lambda, qc opens, proper r=id and p=v, no cartesian requirement, L and k_!L in D^+). Step 2: I checked the transport equation with (V,W,S,T;k,i,r,p)=(X,Xbar1,X,Xbar2;j1,j2,1,v). Its alpha^p is the same clopen-projection composite as in lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate (refinement case = projection onto (j1,1)), so gamma^p is the item's gamma. Its gamma^e is the resolution-normalized map of interchange-coherence. b_1=1 follows from the counit equation of lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate. The transport's o_j and the item's e_j are the same comparison of lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison (advisory: the step does not say so). Both sides run from nu*j2!H to Rv_*j1!K. Step 3: interchange-coherence's refinement clause gives gamma^e=alpha^e; with lem-sf-proper-open-comparison-site-normalization (hypotheses met) and cancelling e_j2 this gives alpha^p_v(H)=gamma_{v,K} as actual maps. Step 4: naturality of gamma at the witness a gives Gamma_v=gamma_{v,M}, and witness independence and naturality in t follow. Edge cases checked: empty X, v=id, an extra clopen component killed by the projection, change of witness. No duplicate of the witnessed equality among the citers of projection-mate and site-normalization. Source is blueprint prop-sf-pf-coherence.proof.md, compactification-independence sentence. No SGA.
